title: The Daily Line NBA 2026-10-21 full 11-game shadow v0.2.1 experiment

baseline_sources.roster_notes: rotowire and verified current roster pages

data_quality_notes.status: EXPERIMENTAL shadow, not trained or calibrated. FAIL PASS quality gate.
data_quality_notes.team_baselines: 2025-26 factual team OffRtg, DefRtg, pace, eFG, REB%, turnover%; latest roster adjusted HEURISTIC not measured
data_quality_notes.four_factors: eFG, TOV team observed under NBA provider-specific definitions; OREB%, FTr, 3PA, opponent eFG and turnover forcing are LEAGUE PRIORS/PROXIES, not team-specific observed metrics
data_quality_notes.player_inputs: 2025-26 PTS/REB/AST, MP partly verified, others approximated and labeled; no verified shot-by-shot player statistics in full slate
data_quality_notes.player_shooting: FGA/3PA/FTA and efficiencies IMPUTED from role/PPG; individual 3PM and ALT props particularly unreliable
data_quality_notes.injury: official 4:45 ET statuses; projected groups NOT confirmed, optimistic questionable-player baseline; conditional alternate computed separately
data_quality_notes.bench: all unlisted bench grouped Other, separate group can total more than 43 minutes
data_quality_notes.missing_advanced: No verified historical five-man stint matrices, WOWY, exact rebound chances, true potential assists, tracking data or defensive schemes; do not claim included
data_quality_notes.stat_reconciliation: 240 regulation player-minutes per team, exact player sum to regulation team points, sharing of rebound/assist/steal/turnover events (limited and simplified)
data_quality_notes.overtime: full-game win/totals use approximate overtime tie breaker; player outputs are regulation-only
data_quality_notes.model_uncertainty: model-draw quantiles understate structural/epistemic uncertainty; use +/-4 rating-shock sensitivity, not a calibration confidence interval
data_quality_notes.market: market odds, market forecasts, outside models, no-vig and fee EV not read by model. PASS/AVOID/WATCH only provisional research WATCH, no PASS.

WAS: Trae Young and Anthony Davis additions; AJ Dybantsa OUT
ATL: Active established core; unvalidated roster shifts
ORL: Black and Isaac OUT; Bane/Paolo core
CHA: LaMelo departure; Knueppel and Coby White OUT
BKN: Randle and Porter Jr additions, Claxton departed
CHI: Norman Powell acquisition; Nic Claxton OUT
NOP: Assumed healthier core; projected starters unconfirmed
UTA: Jaren Jackson Jr acquisition; Nurkic OUT
MEM: Jackson departure, Edey return, rookie Cam Boozer
POR: Morant/Lillard availability, Sharpe OUT, Avdija QUESTIONABLE
GSW: Butler, Moody, Podziemski, Porzingis OUT; Curry probable
SAC: Core Sabonis/LaVine, rookie guard and Monk QUESTIONABLE
LAC: Kawhi departed; Ingram, Beal and multiple reserves OUT
